headline: Approved moving Fair Shair bus shelters to construction and helping with Wobble Before You Gobble 5k road race.
summary: The meeting covered the election of a chairman, bus shelter and road race requests, and existing traffic requests. Members approved Alex Pratt as chairman and moved the Fair Shair bus shelter request to construction. They decided to send letters to City Councilors asking them to resubmit existing requests.
decisions: Approved Alex Pratt as Chairman, by unanimous voice vote.
Approved moving the Fair Shair bus shelter request to the construction phase, by unanimous vote.
Approved a second motion on the Fair Shair bus shelter request, by unanimous voice vote.
Approved help for the Wobble Before You Gobble 5k road race, by unanimous voice vote.
Decided to send letters to City Councilors asking them to resubmit existing Traffic Commission requests; the motion was approved unanimously.
Determined that future meeting dates will be set at the next meeting, scheduled for November 2, 2026 at 5:30 p.m.
Determined that members will not have voting powers if they are not in attendance.

transcript:
# Transportation Commission Meeting Minutes

Monday, September 28, 2026 5:30PM City Hall Room 105 215 Pleasant Street Malden, MA 02148

## 1. Roll Call

- Members in attendance:
  - Alex Pratt, Chairman
  - Lt Ryan Fortier, MPD Chief’s designee
  - Mr. Ron Hogan, Parking Director
  - Mr. Yem Lip, Malden Engineering
  - Mr. Nelson Miller, Building Commission
  - Mardie Sullivan, Clerk
  - Marcella Cannatti, Transportation Planner
- Present and having business before the commission:
  - Mr. Ernie Ardolino, Parking Supervisor

## 2. Election of Officers

- A motion was made by Mr. Ron Hogan seconded by Mr. Nelson Miller and unanimously voice voted to approve Alex Pratt as Chairman.

## 3. Introductions

## 4. Overview of Commission Ordinance and Responsibilities

- Overview of Commission Ordinances and Responsibilities were read.

## 5. Meeting Expectations

- Members will attend in person unless health issues require remote.
- New/Open Request must be sponsored by a Commission Member or City Councilor. Request must be submitted 7 days prior to meeting. A Memo will be sent to City Councilors to discuss.
- Materials will be distributed at least 48 hours in advance
- It was determined that members will not have voting powers if not in attendance.

## 6. Traffic & Parking Regulations

- Preamble and By Laws will be discussed next meeting

## 7. New and Open Requests

- **Request for Fair Shair bus shelters**
  - A request was made by Yem Lip to move forward to the construction phase. A motion was made by Lt Ryan Fortier and seconded by Ron Hogan and unanimously voted to approve
  - A motion was made by Ron Hogan and seconded by Yem Lip and unanimously voice voted to approve.
- **Request for help with Wobble Before You Gobble 5k road race**
  - A request for help with Wobble Before You Gobble 5k Road Race
  - A motion was made by Lt Ryan Fortier and seconded by Yem Lip and unanimously voice voted to approve.
- **Existing requests from Traffic Commission**
  - A motion was made to discuss existing Traffic Commission requests. It was decided to send letters to City Councilors to resubmit requests.
  - A motion was made by Lt Ryan Fortier and seconded by Ron Hogan and unanimously voice voted to approve.

## 8. Ongoing meeting schedule

- Ongoing meeting schedule was discussed and it was determined that future meeting will be determined at the next meeting scheduled for November 2, 2026 at 5:30 p.m.

## 9. Adjournment – 7:00PM

- A motion was made by Lt. Fortier and seconded by Yem Lip to adjourn the meeting and unanimously voice voted to approve.
- Meeting was adjourned as 6:44 pm

Approved 11/02/2026
